description: Post a public comment on an idea, either top-level or as a reply within an existing comment thread (pass parent_id). It posts straight away, labelled in the app as sent through this agent. Post only comments intended by the user. Monnet may respond — if it does, the response is included in the return value.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID.

parent_id.description: Optional id of the top-level comment to reply under — full UUID or 8-char short id, as shown by get_idea. Omit to post a top-level comment. Replies to replies are not allowed (thread depth is 1).

name: comment
